## Safety and rights checklist
- [ ] No credentials, serials, personal/user data or network identifiers included.
- [ ] No ROM, firmware or other material uploaded without authorization.
- [ ] Test uses synthetic data and does not expose a legacy machine to the internet.
- [ ] Claims distinguish host tests, emulation and physical hardware.
